definitions.usage: deceit(-ful, -fully), false, guile, idle, slack, slothful.
definitions.full: H7423. rmiyah I. רְמִיָּה noun feminine deceit, treachery ; — always absolute ׳ר ; — deceit, treachery: especially of speech, predicate of לָשׁוֺן Micah 6:12 (|| שֶׁקֶר ), apposition of לָשׁוֺן (or read לְשֹׁוֺן ?) Psa 120:2 (|| שֶׁקֶר שְׂפַת ), 120:3 ; of man, ר ׳עשֵֹׁה 52:4 that workest treachery , 101:7 (|| שְׁקָדִים דֹּבֵר ); also Job 13:7 ; 27:4 (both || עַוְלָה ); deception Psa 32:2 (|| עָוֺן ); in phrase ר ׳קֶשֶׁת treacherous bow (simile) Hosea 7:16 ; Psa 78:57 (failing him who trusts to it). II. רְמִיָּה noun feminine laxness, slackness ; — always absolute ׳ר ; — ר ׳כַּף Prov 10:4 slack (negligent, idle) hand (opposed to חָרוּצִים יַד ); ׳ר alone = slackness (abstract for concrete = one who is slack) 12:24 (|| id. ), 12:27 (see חרך ); ר ׳נֶפֶשׁ 19:15 (|| עַצְלָה ); as adverb י ׳מְלֶאכֶת רְמִיָּה עשֶֹׁה Jer 48:10 .

occurrences.englishText: Will you speak unrighteously for God,
surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness,
Blessed is the man to whom Yahweh doesn’t impute iniquity,
but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers.
He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house.
Deliver my soul, Yahweh, from lying lips,
What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you,
He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand,
The hands of the diligent ones shall rule,
The slothful man doesn’t roast his game,
Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep.
“Cursed is he who does the work of Yahweh negligently;
They return, but not to the Most High.
Her rich men are full of violence,
